summary: Keep the client-control fixture on its own Fabric node, home and control socket rather than the ambient production Fabric daemon.

schema.detail: No database or client wire schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or membership rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Fixture exposure, grant, revoke and status derive the trusted instance root/fabric home and root/fabric/run/control.sock. Every command pins FABRIC_HOME and global --home, ignoring ambient daemon selection. Other homes, control sockets and symlink aliases are refused before Fabric executes. Ordinary Fabric callers keep existing defaults.

downtime.detail: No production daemon restart or exposure change is required.

manual.detail: The approved fixture packet must start and stop a dedicated Fabric daemon under the fixture root/fabric home within its Fabric-mesh scope, and record the actual dedicated Fabric NodeID separately from the Fractal daemon identity. Source support grants no setup or execution authority.

recovery.detail: Remove fixture peers and exposure through the same explicitly selected fixture home, then stop that dedicated daemon. Do not mutate or restart the production Fabric daemon.
